title: IEEE CASS Student Design Competition 2027
summary: Prepare an electronics / circuits design project, local demonstration and technical reports.
eligibility: Global undergraduate teams, including India through Region 10; mentor and membership conditions apply.

prize.description: Cash prize pool reported in the supplied research.

notes: At least three team members require IEEE/CASS membership for 2026 and 2027.
Final in June 2027. Conference registration and limited travel grants cover up to three members; accommodation is not promised.
